tools.name: zoom
tools.description: Open line id+n of the chat memory view into the two lines of n/2 under it; n = 1 gives message id whole (a long message comes in pages). n is a power of 2 and id a multiple of n. Use it to find the latest mention of anything that may have come up before, before you act, guess or ask.

tools.name: date
tools.description: The date and time of message id of the chat memory.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search every message of the chat memory, and the saved decisions, lessons and notes, by their words. Returns the best hits as id|date|kind|snippet (a saved record is rec:<id>); a hit is only a snippet that drops detail, so open the message with zoom(id, 1) before you answer from it. Optional since/until limit it to a date range. Use it when the view shows a topic only as a word, or to find where something was said.

tools.name: project
tools.description: Where a project stands, in a few lines: its latest decisions (the ones a later decision replaced are marked SUPERSEDED), open loops, and the end state of its last session. Every line starts with an id that zoom opens (rec:<id>, th:<id>, ls:<id>). Call it when you start work on a project and need its current state, before you ask the owner to re-explain. Without a name it uses the project of the working directory.

tools.name: doc
tools.description: Open a docs write-up that a search doc handle points to (the `doc|date|path|heading|snippet` lines under the hits), whole or one section. Only files under docs/state, docs/design, docs/research and docs/decisions of the owner's repos open.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main
